info.title: AI-BOM Local Serve API
info.description: Local OSS BOM HTTP snapshot (stdlib `http.server`; hosted inventory = paid later). Documents `GET /health`, `GET /ready`, `GET /bom.json`, `GET /v1/bom?format=json|cyclonedx|cyclonedx-xml|spdx|spdx-xml|spdx3|sarif|md|gha|html` (default json = internal AI-BOM; cyclonedx = CycloneDX 1.7 JSON; cyclonedx-xml = CycloneDX 1.7 XML; spdx = SPDX 2.3 JSON; spdx-xml = SPDX 2.3 XML; spdx3 = SPDX 3.0.1 JSON; sarif = SARIF 2.1.0 same as CLI `--sarif`; md = human/Slack Markdown summary (`text/markdown`; not an SBOM spec); gha = GitHub Actions workflow commands (`::error`/`::notice`; `text/plain`; alias annotations); html = self-contained HTML BOM summary (`text/html`; no CDN; policy hits red); optional `GET /v1/bom.sarif` / `GET /v1/bom.xml` / `GET /v1/bom.spdx.xml` / `GET /v1/bom.md` / `GET /v1/bom.gha.txt` / `GET /v1/bom.html`; `/bom.json` unchanged), `GET /v1/policy` (active license/policy gate: `forbiddenLicenseIds`, `forbiddenPatterns` ids, `exceptionsCount`, `ignoreFile`; **200** even if no policy file — empty lists; never dumps file contents, regexes, exception reasons, or secrets), `GET /v1/config` (redacted runtime knobs: `ok`, `rateLimit.perMinute`, `cors.origins`, `watch`, `scanPathBase` basename only, `hasPolicyFile`, `webhooks.hasUrl` / `webhooks.hasSecret`; **never** webhook URL/secret, full policy JSON — that is `/v1/policy` — or exception file contents), `GET /v1/components` (lightweight inventory from the last scan: `{ok, count, components:[{name, version, license, path}]}`; `path` is relative to scan root or basename — never an absolute host path; empty scan → `{ok:true, count:0, components:[]}` **200**; optional `?license=` case-insensitive exact filter; cap **500** with `truncated:true`; not CycloneDX/SPDX), `GET /v1/exceptions` (redacted license-exception / waiver inventory: `{ok, count, exceptions:[{component, license, expiresAt, expired}]}`; `count` is the full waiver count; array cap **500** original file order with `truncated:true` when more; empty / no sidecar → `{ok:true, count:0, exceptions:[]}` **200**; optional `?expired=true|false` (unknown value → empty list 200); never sidecar path, full policy JSON, webhook URL/secret, API keys, or raw file dump), `GET /evidence.md`, `GET /`, `GET /openapi.json`, `GET /metrics` (Prometheus text: `ai_bom_component_count`, `ai_bom_policy_hits`, `ai_bom_forbidden_licenses`). `GET /ready` is **200** `{ok:true, service}` plus the same snapshot fields as `/health` when healthy (stateless; no circuit/queue). On SIGTERM/SIGINT, **503** `{ok:false, reason:"shutting_down"}` (liveness `GET /health` stays 200 with `shuttingDown: true` while draining). Compose/stack-demo healthchecks stay on `/health`. `GET /openapi.json` serves this file. Default scan runs once at process start. Optional `serve --watch` polls scan-root max mtime (~500ms) and rescans the snapshot used by `/bom.json`, `/health`, `/metrics`, `/` (and `/ready`; OpenAPI stays file-backed). Optional `X-Request-Id` request header: echoed on **every** response (including 4xx / OPTIONS). If omitted or empty, the server generates a UUID (max 128 chars; CR/LF stripped). Default allow/expose CORS headers include `X-Request-Id`. **403 CORS**: optional `--cors-origins` CSV or env `AI_BOM_CORS_ORIGINS` (`*` allowed). Default omitted/empty = no extra CORS headers (deny; OPTIONS **404**). When enabled with an explicit list, OPTIONS preflight for a listed Origin → **204** with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` / `Allow-Methods` / `Allow-Headers`; unlisted Origin (e.g. `http://evil.example`) → **403** `{error:"forbidden",reason:"cors_denied"}` (no ACAO). Matching GET includes ACAO. GET from a disallowed Origin still executes (e.g. 200) but omits ACAO. local-mvp isolated prove uses `http://localhost:3000`; main serve / stack-demo default deny. **429 rate limit**: `--rate-limit` / env `RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` (alias `RATE_LIMIT_RPM`) default **120** requests/minute per client IP (`X-Forwarded-For` first hop, else socket). In-memory sliding window. Exceed → `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`. `/health`, `/ready`, `/metrics` are **not** rate-limited (k8s probes / Prometheus). Default `Access-Control-Expose-Headers` includes `Retry-After` and `X-Request-Id` (browser JS can read 429 `Retry-After`). 0 disables the limit. Optional scan-root `.aibom-exceptions.json` (and CLI `--exceptions` / env `AI_BOM_EXCEPTIONS`) applies named component+license waivers (`summary.waived`; expired still count as hits in `expiredExceptions`). Query `?exceptions=` / `?exceptions=skip` on `/bom.json` and `/v1/bom` reconstructs un-waived hits. Bad exceptions JSON does not 500.

tags.name: health
tags.description: Liveness (GET /health always 200; shuttingDown true while draining) and readiness (GET /ready 200 when healthy, 503 shutting_down while draining)

tags.name: bom
tags.description: CycloneDX-like BOM JSON + bilingual evidence + HTML summary + GET /v1/bom?format=json|cyclonedx|cyclonedx-xml|spdx|spdx-xml|spdx3|sarif|md|gha|html + GET /v1/policy (license/policy gate ids/counts; no file dump) + GET /v1/config (redacted knobs; no secrets) + GET /v1/components (lightweight inventory table; no CycloneDX/SPDX download) + GET /v1/exceptions (redacted waiver inventory; no sidecar dump)

get.description: Liveness plus snapshot `componentCount`, `policyHits`, and license counts. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied` (see info). Not rate-limited.

200.description: Server is up (scan snapshot at process start)

get.description: Readiness. **200** `{ok:true, service}` plus snapshot `componentCount`, `policyHits`, and license counts (same as `/health`) when healthy. On SIGTERM/SIGINT, **503** `{ok:false, reason:"shutting_down"}` (liveness `GET /health` stays 200 with `shuttingDown: true`). Stateless scan snapshot — no circuit/queue. Compose/stack-demo healthchecks stay on `/health`. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Not rate-limited.

200.description: Ready (same snapshot fields as GET /health). 200 when healthy; 503 `{ok:false, reason:"shutting_down"}` while draining SIGTERM/SIGINT.

503.description: Not ready: process is shutting down after SIGTERM/SIGINT. `{ok:false, reason:"shutting_down"}`. GET /health stays 200 with `shuttingDown: true` while draining.

get.description: Full scan result (`bomFormat=CycloneDX`) including components, SPDX licenses, and policy summary. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`. Optional `?exceptions=skip` omits applied waivers for this response.

get.summary: BOM export (json | cyclonedx | cyclonedx-xml | spdx | spdx-xml | spdx3 | sarif | md | gha | html)
get.description: Versioned BOM snapshot. Query `format=json` (default) is the internal AI-BOM (same body as `GET /bom.json`). `format=cyclonedx` is CycloneDX 1.7 JSON (`bomFormat` + `specVersion`). `format=cyclonedx-xml` is CycloneDX 1.7 XML (`bom` xmlns 1.7; same components/licenses/`aibom:*` properties; alias `cdx-xml`). `format=spdx` is SPDX 2.3 JSON (`spdxVersion` + `packages` + `documentNamespace`). `format=spdx-xml` is SPDX 2.3 XML (`SpdxDocument` + `spdxVersion` SPDX-2.3 + packages/`licenseConcluded`; alias `spdxxml`; path alias `GET /v1/bom.spdx.xml`). `format=spdx3` is SPDX 3.0.1 JSON (`spdxId` + `name` + `creationInfo.specVersion` 3.0.1 + `element` packages/licenses; alias `spdx-3`). `format=sarif` is SARIF 2.1.0 JSON (`version` + `runs`; same builder as CLI `--sarif`). `format=md` is a human/Slack Markdown summary (`# AI-BOM` + component/policyHits/waived counts; `text/markdown`; not an SBOM spec; path alias `GET /v1/bom.md`). `format=gha` is GitHub Actions workflow commands (`::error title=<component>::<license or rule>` / waived `::notice`; `text/plain`; alias `annotations`; path alias `GET /v1/bom.gha.txt`; clean scan → empty 200). `format=html` is a self-contained HTML BOM summary (`text/html`; component count + license table + policy hits / forbidden licenses in red if any; names escaped; empty scan still 200 with heading; path alias `GET /v1/bom.html`; not an SBOM spec). Unknown format → **400** `{error:"bad_format"}`. Existing `/bom.json` clients are unchanged. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`. Optional `?exceptions=skip` omits applied waivers (same as `/bom.json`).

200.description: BOM snapshot in the requested format

get.description: Same body as `GET /v1/bom?format=sarif` (SARIF 2.1.0; `version` + `runs`; same builder as CLI `--sarif`). Content-Type `application/sarif+json`. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`.

Same body as `GET /v1/bom?format=cyclonedx-xml` (CycloneDX 1.7 XML; `bom` xmlns `http://cyclonedx.org/schema/bom/1.7`; empty components still 200). Content-Type `application/vnd.cyclonedx+xml`. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`.

Same body as `GET /v1/bom?format=spdx-xml` (SPDX 2.3 XML; root `SpdxDocument` with `spdxVersion` SPDX-2.3, packages, licenseConcluded; empty packages still 200). Content-Type `application/spdx+xml`. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`.

get.summary: Markdown BOM summary alias (same as GET /v1/bom?format=md)
get.description: Same body as `GET /v1/bom?format=md` (human/Slack Markdown: `# AI-BOM` + **components** / **policyHits** / **waived** + license / policy-hit / waived tables; empty scan still 200). Content-Type `text/markdown`. Not an SBOM spec. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`.

200.description: Markdown BOM summary (heading + zeros is still 200)

get.summary: HTML BOM summary alias (same as GET /v1/bom?format=html)
get.description: Same body as `GET /v1/bom?format=html` (self-contained HTML: heading + component count + license summary + policy hits / forbidden licenses; fail rows red; names escaped with stdlib `html.escape`; empty scan still 200). Content-Type `text/html; charset=utf-8`. No CDN. Not an SBOM spec. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`.

200.description: HTML BOM summary (heading + zeros is still 200)

get.summary: GitHub Actions annotations alias (same as GET /v1/bom?format=gha)
get.description: Same body as `GET /v1/bom?format=gha` (workflow commands: `::error title=<component>::<license or rule>` for policy hits / forbidden licenses; waived `::notice title=<component>::waived <reason>`; clean scan → empty body 200, no `::error`). Content-Type `text/plain`. Does not require GitHub. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`.

200.description: GHA workflow commands (empty body is still 200)

get.description: Returns the loaded policy pack as a small JSON gate: `ok`, `forbiddenLicenseIds` (SPDX ids from the pack), `forbiddenPatterns` (pattern **ids** only, not regexes), `exceptionsCount` (sidecar count, not reasons), `ignoreFile` (whether scan-root `.aibomignore` exists). Missing / unloaded policy file → **200** with empty lists. Never dumps policy file contents, ignore-file lines, exception reasons, or secrets. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`.

200.description: Active gate (empty lists when no policy file)

get.description: Public snapshot of non-secret runtime **knobs** (not the policy dump). Same auth as `GET /v1/policy` (no token). Allowlist only: `ok`, `rateLimit.perMinute` (null if unlimited), `cors.origins`, `watch` (`serve --watch`), `scanPathBase` (basename of `--path` only — never a full host path), `hasPolicyFile`, `webhooks.hasUrl` / `webhooks.hasSecret` (booleans — **never** the webhook URL, which may contain query tokens, and **never** the secret). **Forbidden:** webhook URL, webhook secret, full policy JSON (see `GET /v1/policy`), exception file contents. CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. Rate-limited like `/v1/policy` (not a probe path).

Table-friendly inventory from the last scan snapshot: `{ok, count, components:[{name, version, license, path}]}`. Buyers get a list without downloading CycloneDX/SPDX (`GET /v1/bom` unchanged). `path` is relative to the scan root when possible, otherwise the basename — **never** an absolute host path. Empty scan → **200** `{ok:true, count:0, components:[]}`. Optional `?license=` is a case-insensitive exact match on the license label (SPDX id or name). List is capped at **500**; `truncated: true` when more match. CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`.

200.description: Inventory (empty list when the last scan has no components)

get.description: Public waiver table from the loaded sidecar (scan-root `.aibom-exceptions.json` and optional `--exceptions`): `{ok, count, exceptions:[{component, license, expiresAt, expired}]}`. `count` is the full waiver count (before cap). Array keeps original file order and is capped at **500**; `truncated: true` only when more. Empty / no exceptions file → **200** `{ok:true, count:0, exceptions:[]}`. `expiresAt` is the stored date string (YYYY-MM-DD) or `null`. `expired` uses the same expiry rule as the scanner (`expires` < today UTC). Optional `?expired=true|false` filters the list; unknown value → empty list **200** (not 400). Optional `reason` is included only when it is a short human note already on the sidecar and does not look like a secret. **Never** sidecar file path, full policy JSON, webhook URL/secret, API keys, Authorization, exception file dump, or ignore-file body. Same auth as `GET /v1/policy` (no token). CORS + `X-Request-Id`. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`.

200.description: Redacted waiver inventory (empty list when no sidecar)

get.description: Auditor-facing EN/中文 DRAFT evidence (policy hits, license summary, exit guidance). CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`.

Self-contained HTML: component count, license summary, policy hits. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`. Explicit HTML export: `GET /v1/bom.html` / `GET /v1/bom?format=html` (same formatter).

Prometheus text exposition of the BOM scan snapshot (computed once at process start). Gauges: `ai_bom_component_count`, `ai_bom_policy_hits`, `ai_bom_forbidden_licenses`. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Matching GET includes ACAO (same as other GET). Not rate-limited.

text/plain.example:
# TYPE ai_bom_component_count gauge
ai_bom_component_count 4
# TYPE ai_bom_policy_hits gauge
ai_bom_policy_hits 1
# TYPE ai_bom_forbidden_licenses gauge
ai_bom_forbidden_licenses 0

get.description: File-backed spec from `openapi/bom.openapi.json`. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Rate limit exceeded → **429** `{ok:false, reason:"rate_limited"}` + `Retry-After`.

500.description: Spec file missing or invalid JSON

AccessControlAllowOrigin.description: Echoed when request Origin matches `--cors-origins` / `AI_BOM_CORS_ORIGINS` (or `*` when configured). Absent when CORS disabled or origin not allowed.

XRequestId.description: Echo of incoming `X-Request-Id`, or a generated UUID when the request header is omitted/empty. Present on every response (incl 4xx / OPTIONS).

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a rate-limited request.

path.description: Scan root used for this snapshot

shuttingDown.description: Present and true while draining SIGTERM/SIGINT. Omitted otherwise so stack-demo /health is unchanged.

waived.description: Applied license exceptions (not policy failures). {component, license, reason}.

expiredExceptions.description: Matching exceptions whose expires < today UTC; still policy hits.

CorsConfig.description: Optional CORS. Default omitted or empty origins = no extra CORS headers (deny). `origins` may be `["*"]` (any Origin) or an explicit list. When enabled with an explicit list, OPTIONS preflight for a non-listed Origin returns **403** `{error:"forbidden",reason:"cors_denied"}`; allowed Origin → **204** with ACAO/ACAM/ACAH. Matching GET get Access-Control-Allow-Origin. local-mvp uses `["http://localhost:3000"]`. Default `Access-Control-Expose-Headers` includes `Retry-After` and `X-Request-Id`.

origins.description: `["*"]` or explicit origins. Empty/omitted disables CORS.

Ready.description: GET /ready body. 200 `{ok:true, service}` plus the same snapshot fields as GET /health when healthy. 503 `{ok:false, reason:"shutting_down"}` while draining SIGTERM/SIGINT. Snapshot/stateless — no circuit or queue. Compose/stack-demo healthchecks stay on `/health`.

BomExport.description: Union of internal AI-BOM (`format=json`), CycloneDX 1.7 JSON (`bomFormat`+`specVersion`), CycloneDX 1.7 XML (`format=cyclonedx-xml`), SPDX 2.3 JSON (`spdxVersion`+`packages`), SPDX 2.3 XML (`format=spdx-xml`), SPDX 3.0.1 JSON (`format=spdx3`, `creationInfo.specVersion`), SARIF 2.1.0 (`version`+`runs`), Markdown summary (`format=md`), or GitHub Actions annotations (`format=gha`).

PolicyGate.description: Active license/policy gate. Ids and counts only — never file contents, regexes, exception reasons, or secrets. 200 with empty lists when no policy is loaded.

forbiddenLicenseIds.description: SPDX ids from policy `forbiddenLicenseIds` (the license gate, not scan hits).

forbiddenPatterns.description: Forbidden-pattern **ids** only (not regex / message / file contents).

exceptionsCount.description: Count of loaded license exceptions (sidecar). Reasons are not included.

ignoreFile.description: True when scan-root `.aibomignore` exists. File contents are not included.

RuntimeConfig.description: Public redacted runtime config (GET /v1/config). Allowlist only — never webhook URL, webhook secret, full policy JSON, exception file contents, or a full host scan path. Knobs, not the license gate (ids stay on GET /v1/policy). Mirrors C/E/F GET /v1/config; D has no admin token on this GET.

origins.description: Allowed Origins (`["*"]` = any). Empty = CORS disabled.

watch.description: True when `serve --watch` is polling scan-root mtime.

scanPathBase.description: Basename of `--path` only (never a full host path that might leak user dirs). Omitted when the basename is empty or `.`.

hasPolicyFile.description: True when `--policy` loaded a pack. Full gate JSON stays on GET /v1/policy.

webhooks.description: Outbound policy-hit webhook presence (`scan --webhook-url` / env, or serve flags for this snapshot). Booleans only — never the URL (query tokens) or secret.

hasUrl.description: True when `--webhook-url` / `AI_BOM_WEBHOOK_URL` is set. The URL itself is never returned.

hasSecret.description: True when `--webhook-secret` / `AI_BOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is set. The secret itself is never returned.

InventoryComponent.description: One inventory row. `path` is relative to the scan root or a basename — never an absolute host path.

version.description: Empty string when the scan has no version.

license.description: SPDX id, expression, or name (`UNKNOWN` / `NOASSERTION` when unset).

path.description: Relative to scan root, or basename. Never an absolute host path.

ComponentInventory.description: Lightweight inventory (GET /v1/components). Not CycloneDX/SPDX. Empty scan is still 200 with count 0.

count.description: Number of rows in `components` (after filter and cap).

truncated.description: True when more than 500 rows matched (list capped at 500). Omitted when not truncated.

ExceptionRow.description: One redacted waiver row. Never includes sidecar path, secrets, or a raw file dump.

expiresAt.description: Stored expiry (YYYY-MM-DD) or null when the waiver has no expiry.

expired.description: True when `expires` < today UTC (same rule as the scanner). Expired waivers still fail the license gate.

reason.description: Optional short human note already on the sidecar. Omitted when missing, long, or secret-like.

ExceptionInventory.description: Redacted waiver inventory (GET /v1/exceptions). Empty / no sidecar is still 200 with count 0. Never dumps the exceptions file.

count.description: Full matching waiver count (after optional `?expired=` filter, before the 500 cap).

truncated.description: True when more than 500 waivers matched (list capped at 500). Omitted when not truncated.

CorsDenied.description: CORS preflight (OPTIONS) for an Origin not in `--cors-origins` / `AI_BOM_CORS_ORIGINS`. Body `{error:"forbidden",reason:"cors_denied"}`. No `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`. Does not apply when CORS is disabled (then OPTIONS is 404 without ACAO). GET from a disallowed Origin still execute (e.g. 200) but omit ACAO.

RateLimited.description: Sliding-window rate limit exceeded (client IP, X-Forwarded-For first hop). Retry after `Retry-After` seconds. `/health`, `/ready`, `/metrics` are not rate-limited.

XRequestId.name: X-Request-Id
XRequestId.description: Optional correlation id. Echoed on every response as `X-Request-Id`. If omitted/empty, the server generates a UUID (max 128 chars; CR/LF stripped).

BomFormat.name: format
BomFormat.description: Export format. `json` (default) is the internal AI-BOM with `summary`. `cyclonedx` is CycloneDX 1.7 JSON. `cyclonedx-xml` is CycloneDX 1.7 XML (`application/vnd.cyclonedx+xml`; alias `cdx-xml`; path alias `GET /v1/bom.xml`). `spdx` is SPDX 2.3 JSON. `spdx-xml` is SPDX 2.3 XML (`application/spdx+xml`; alias `spdxxml`; path alias `GET /v1/bom.spdx.xml`). `spdx3` is SPDX 3.0.1 JSON (`creationInfo.specVersion` 3.0.1; alias `spdx-3`). `sarif` is SARIF 2.1.0 JSON (same as CLI `--sarif`; GitHub code scanning). `md` is a human/Slack Markdown summary (`text/markdown`; alias `markdown`; path alias `GET /v1/bom.md`; not an SBOM spec). `gha` is GitHub Actions workflow commands (`text/plain`; alias `annotations`; path alias `GET /v1/bom.gha.txt`; `::error` / waived `::notice`; clean → empty). `html` is a self-contained HTML BOM summary (`text/html`; path alias `GET /v1/bom.html`; no CDN; policy hits red; not an SBOM spec). Existing `GET /bom.json` is always internal json. Alias: `GET /v1/bom.sarif`.

ExceptionsSkip.name: exceptions
ExceptionsSkip.description: Skip applying license exceptions for this response. Empty / `skip` / `0` / `false` / `off` / `none` reconstructs un-waived forbidden-license hits. Omitted = apply scan-root `.aibom-exceptions.json`. Does not load a file path from the query.

LicenseFilter.name: license
LicenseFilter.description: Case-insensitive exact match on the component license label (SPDX id or name, e.g. `MIT`). Omit to return all.

ExpiredFilter.name: expired
ExpiredFilter.description: Filter by expiry. `true` / `false` only. Unknown value → empty list **200** (not 400). Omit to return all.
